title: Married Ever After: Building a Muslim Home
description: Building a Muslim home upon the Qur'an and Sunnah: marriage as worship, raising righteous children, and barakah in the household. Lessons from Newcastle Central Mosque, AMAU Academy, Ulul Absaar Project, and Umm Uthmaan al-Majariyyah - all Salafi sources.
short_description: Marriage and family life on Islamic principles

modules.title: Preparing for Marriage
modules.description: Choosing the right spouse and starting a righteous family.

lessons.title: Marriage: The Start of a Muslim Family
lessons.content: Why marriage is worship, and how to begin married life with the intention of pleasing Allah. Ustadh Muhammad Tim Humble, AMAU.

lessons.title: Choosing a Righteous Wife
lessons.content: How to choose a righteous spouse: piety over beauty and wealth, and the signs of a good partner. Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan, AMAU.

lessons.title: #3: On the Road to A Righteous Husband
lessons.content: What a woman should look for in a husband: deen, character and responsibility. AMAU.

lessons.title: Marriage That Builds Your Imaan
lessons.content: How marriage strengthens your iman and relationship with Allah - beyond love and companionship. Newcastle Central Mosque.

modules.title: Raising Righteous Children
modules.description: The parents' responsibility and how to raise children firm on Islam.

lessons.title: How to Raise Children Firm on Islam
lessons.content: Practical guidance for raising children upon the Qur'an and Sunnah in a modern world. Newcastle Central Mosque.

lessons.title: Parenting Through The Storm
lessons.content: Dealing with rebellion, hardship and the tests of raising children. Newcastle Central Mosque.

lessons.title: Timeless Lessons from Luqmaan's Advice
lessons.content: Luqman's advice to his son (Qur'an 31:13-19): tawheed, gratitude to parents, and character. Newcastle Central Mosque.

lessons.title: #59 Everything You Need To Know About Marriage
lessons.content: A comprehensive overview: from choice, to nikaah, to building a home with barakah. Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan, AMAU.

lessons.title: Practical Steps to Solve Marital Problems
lessons.content: How couples should handle disagreements and conflict the Prophetic way. Ustadh Muhammad Tim Humble, AMAU.

lessons.title: The Blueprint for a Successful Marriage (1/2)
lessons.content: The practical blueprint for a successful Islamic marriage: foundation, expectations and daily life. Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan, AMAR.
